title: Gradient Descent Sandbox
summary: Random walker performs gradient descent on a procedural heightfield, leaving a trail that visualises optimisation steps.

vr_notes.comfort: Only the walker moves slowly; camera and terrain stay static.
vr_notes.interaction: Call `reset_descent()` to randomise starts or tweak exports for live demos.
vr_notes.performance: Single dynamic mesh with <300 segments and two immediate line meshes; negligible cost.

parameters.name: learning_rate
parameters.description: Step size multiplier for the downhill update.

parameters.name: gradient_sample_distance
parameters.description: Offset used when estimating the gradient via finite differences.

parameters.name: stop_gradient_magnitude
parameters.description: Terminate descent when the gradient magnitude falls below this value.
